summary: Live traffic labels now show both the callsign and the aircraft type, so a target is identifiable without opening its card.
releaseNotes: The 2D map and 3D globe labels now show callsign, aircraft type and altitude or flight level together.
The selected aircraft and own-ship marker show the same callsign and type, with the type normalised to an ICAO code.
Longer 3D labels are width-limited and ellipsized instead of running off the map.
